outcome.terminalTranscript:
Run the Mistral Vibe interactive CLI

Usage: vibe [OPTIONS] [INITIAL_PROMPT]

Arguments:
  [INITIAL_PROMPT]  

Options:
  -v, --version                          
  -p, --prompt [<PROMPT>]                
      --output <OUTPUT>                  [default: text] [possible values: text, json, streaming]
      --resume [<RESUME>]                
  -c, --continue                         
      --workdir <WORKDIR>                
      --add-dir <ADD_DIRECTORIES>        
      --trust                            
      --agent <AGENT>                    
      --enabled-tools <ENABLED_TOOLS>    
      --disabled-tools <DISABLED_TOOLS>  
      --max-turns <MAX_TURNS>            
      --max-tokens <MAX_TOKENS>          
      --max-price <MAX_PRICE>            
      --auto-approve                     [alias: --yolo]
      --setup                            
      --check-upgrade                    
      --worktree <WORKTREE>              
  -h, --help                             Print help
